fields.summary_ko.0: Micron Technology (MU) has risen approximately 1,010% over the past 5 years, recording Q4 FY2026 revenue of $54.2 billion (+380% YoY) and non-GAAP EPS of $33.42 (+1,000%) due to surging AI infrastructure memory demand.
fields.summary_ko.1: The company holds 18% HBM and 21% DRAM market share, with half of SK Hynix's 2027–2028 production already sold and demand expected to continue through 2030.
